texts.title: Brainstem (approx.)
texts.what: Responsible for breathing, heart rate, swallowing and alertness.

texts.title: Right parietal lobe (approx.)
texts.what: Responsible for touch, body position and sense of space.

texts.title: Left parietal lobe (approx.)
texts.what: Responsible for touch, body position and sense of space.

texts.title: Right temporal lobe (approx.)
texts.what: Responsible for hearing, memory and, usually on the left, language.

texts.title: Left temporal lobe (approx.)
texts.what: Responsible for hearing, memory and, usually on the left, language.

texts.title: Right frontal lobe (approx.)
texts.what: Responsible for planning, decisions, personality and, at its back edge, movement.

texts.title: Left frontal lobe (approx.)
texts.what: Responsible for planning, decisions, personality and, at its back edge, movement.

texts.title: Peritumoral edema (swelling)
texts.what: Edema: swollen brain tissue around the tumor (bright on FLAIR / T2).
texts.effect: It adds pressure on nearby brain (mass effect) and often causes headaches; steroids can reduce it.

texts.title: Enhancing (active) tumor
texts.what: Active tumor: the growing rim where contrast leaks through damaged blood vessels.
texts.effect: This is the part doctors measure to judge whether treatment is working (RANO).

texts.title: Necrotic / non-enhancing tumor core
texts.what: Necrotic core: dead tumor tissue in the middle.
texts.effect: A sign of fast growth, typical of high-grade gliomas; it does not shrink much with treatment.

texts.title: Deep brain (thalamus / basal ganglia) (approx.)
texts.what: Responsible for relaying signals and controlling movement.
